objective: Prevent selected P2 effects from enabling until generic authority repair, the selected exact effect, applicable App binding, offline verification, and P2 surface closure join in one signed checkpoint.
falsifiable_claim: A selected P2 effect is enabled while any applicable dependency is open or while this gate alone is treated as stage closure.

canon_snapshot.snapshot_role: Provenance for the canon revision this record was authored against. Drift detection is owned by generated/canon-baseline.v1.json via tools/canon-impact.mjs.

conditional_dependency_work_item_ids.when: SCM publication is the selected P2 exact effect
the selected P2 journey uses the Hypervisor App attach route

in_scope: Only selected P2 journeys that exercise attach or consequential effects; join signed/offline evidence and negative reachability.
out_of_scope: Selecting future v3 standing authority for exact-effect-only work.
implementation_actions: Materialize the selected dependency set and refuse enablement on any missing, stale, unsigned, inconclusive, or release-mismatched proof.
consequential_effects_and_final_invokers: No effect is owned here; this aggregate gates effects owned by selected children.
metrics_and_frozen_thresholds: Every selected child is verified for the same release and profile; zero bypass paths.
compatibility_and_migration: Non-effect P2 work does not acquire this dependency; v1/v2 authority history and exact-effect profiles remain unchanged.
positive_proof: The selected-profile checkpoint joins generic repair, exact effect, App binding when selected, offline proof, and surface closure.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Missing child, stale release, profile mismatch, unsigned export, and hidden fallback prevent enablement.
remaining_nonclaims: This aggregate neither implements an effect nor closes M9/P2 by its existence.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Disable the selected effect whenever any joined proof ceases to match the content-bound release.
